history.note: Seed point — last-100 window from the original page. From the first 50-game run on, points are last-50.

criteria: Output — per-minute damage / damage taken / assists, blended with share of your own team's totals, graded within your role archetype (Damage / Frontline / Support). Only when damage data exists — PlayARAM's match list does not show damage, so Output stays blank from PlayARAM and fills from a manual CSV.
KDA efficiency — kills, deaths and assists weighed against the archetype's expected line.
Teamplay — kill participation: (kills + assists) ÷ team kills. Only when team totals are available.
Death quality — deaths per game, graded within role (fewer deaths is better).

Conversion — your share of your team's structure takedowns (turrets + inhibitors ÷ team total). Only when per-player structure data exists — not shown on PlayARAM's match list, so it stays blank from PlayARAM.
Augments — how the augments you drafted performed across the group's games in this window. PlayARAM names are read from the match list when the page exposes them; otherwise this scores a neutral 50.
Mechanics — skillshots dodged per minute, from PlayARAM's match list. Shown as a subscore; not blended into the game grade.
how_rating_works.formula: Performance Score = 55% mean game grade + 20% median grade + 10% floor (25th percentile) grade + 15% win rate
how_rating_works.mmr_formula: MMR-style = 800 + Performance Score × 14 — 1500 is roughly average
how_rating_works.not_measured: PlayARAM does not publish healing, shielding, crowd-control score or per-player objective damage, so none of those appear here.

ranking_method.title: How the ranking is fair — whole performance, role-adjusted, champion-adjusted
ranking_method.one_line: No single stat decides the rank. Every game is graded on the criteria the data source provides for that game, each graded only against players in the same role, and then adjusted for the champion played.
points: Role first: every component is a percentile WITHIN the player's role archetype — Damage (ADC / mage / assassin carry), Frontline (tank / fighter), or Support — across all player-games in the window. A tank with 8 kills can score 90th percentile for Frontline while a carry with 12 kills scores only 60th for Damage. Raw kills and damage never compare a tank to a carry.

Champion second: each component is blended 70% archetype percentile + 30% same-champion percentile (only when the group has 3+ games on that champion; otherwise archetype only). Playing a champion well *for that champion* counts, not just picking a strong champion.

Whole performance, not one stat: a game grade is the mean of the criteria available for that game — from PlayARAM: KDA Efficiency, Teamplay, Death Quality and Augments. Output and Conversion join in only when damage / structure data exists (a manual CSV). Mechanics (skillshots dodged) is shown as a 7th subscore but is not blended into the grade. KDA is 1 of the graded criteria, damage is only part of Output, and win rate is only 15% of the final score. A missing field is skipped, never scored as 0.
Consistency counts: Performance Score = 55% mean game grade + 20% median grade + 10% floor (25th percentile) grade + 15% win rate. One pop-off game can't carry a rank; a low floor pulls it down.

Evidence on every card: each player card shows their subscores vs the group average, their grade split by role played, their best / worst champions vs their own average (with game counts), and a 'Why this rank' paragraph built from those numbers — so a complaint can be answered with the breakdown, not an opinion.
ranking_method.criteria_weights: Each available criterion counts equally inside a game grade. Win rate is 15% of the final Performance Score, not the ranking itself.

archetypes.Damage: ADC / mage / assassin carries — judged on damage, kills and carry output
archetypes.Frontline: Tanks / fighters — judged on damage taken, damage soaked per death, and frontline output
archetypes.Support: Enchanters / wardens — judged on assists, teamplay and support output, not carry damage
